Use-case & requirements (short):
- Workload: multi-tenant chat agents with real-time streaming and two-way tool calling (search, payments, CRM writes).
- Latency: target 95th% per-token streaming latency < 300ms; end-to-end round-trip for tool-calls < 600ms preferred.
- Throughput: moderate concurrency per tenant (10-50 concurrent agents), up to 2k aggregated RPS across system.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; wants predictable per-tenant unit economics and option to move to Dedicated for committed volume.
- Model preferences: open models for cost + fallback to Redwood-verified larger variants; need ability to route lower-tier tenants to quantized/cheaper model.
- Routing/fallback: automated fallback to smaller model on capacity or cost rules; transparent quality metrics.

Key asks in POC:
- Stable streaming (no frame loss) under 200-250 RPS sustained for 10 minutes.
- Tenant-level quotas + burst allowance (configurable per plan). Example: "gold" tenants get 100 concurrent streams + 30s burst; "silver" 20 concurrent.
- Rate limiting that integrates with their tenancy metadata (tenant_id header).
- Observable metrics per-tenant: token counts, avg/95/99 latency, error rates.
- Demo of tool-calling flow with guaranteed ordering and retries.
- Pricing: clear delta Hosted -> Dedicated (committed vCPU/GPU) including burst pricing.
